report_name: AMOS Stealer Uses Deceptive Setup Guides to Target macOS Systems

attack_patterns.name: User Execution: Malicious File
attack_patterns.description: The user is socially engineered to visit a malicious website and copy a curl command, which they then paste and execute in a Terminal window, initiating the infection.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
attack_patterns.description: A Z-shell (Zsh) script was downloaded and executed via a pipe from a curl command to stage and run the primary AMOS malware payload.

attack_patterns.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
attack_patterns.description: The legitimate macOS tool 'curl' was used to download the initial malicious Zsh script from an attacker-controlled domain.

attack_patterns.name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Sudo and Sudo Caching
attack_patterns.description: The malware installation script prompts the user for their password, which grants administrative privileges to install the payload and establish persistence.

attack_patterns.name: Create or Modify System Process: LaunchAgent
attack_patterns.description: A malicious .plist file was created at `/tmp/starter` to establish persistence for the main stealer payload, pointing to a shell script that runs the binary.

attack_patterns.name: Hide Artifacts: Hidden Files and Directories
attack_patterns.description: The malware created dot-prefixed directories, such as `.com.apple.accountsd` and `.com.apple.metadata.mds`, in `/Library/Application Support/` to conceal its persistence scripts and payloads.

attack_patterns.name: Archive Collected Data: Archive via Utility
attack_patterns.description: Collected sensitive data was compressed into a single archive named `out.zip` in the `/tmp` directory before exfiltration.

attack_patterns.name: Credentials from Password Stores
attack_patterns.description: AMOS stealer scans the system for credentials, cookies, and wallet files from web browsers and cryptocurrency wallets.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The compressed archive `out.zip` containing stolen data was exfiltrated to the C2 server via HTTP POST requests.

attack_patterns.name: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
attack_patterns.description: HTTP POST requests were used to exfiltrate stolen data to the command and control server.

malware.name: Atomic macOS Stealer
malware.description: An information-stealing malware targeting macOS, designed to exfiltrate system information, login credentials, cookies, and data from cryptocurrency wallets. It is distributed via deceptive websites that trick users into executing malicious scripts.

tools.name: curl
tools.description: Used to download a malicious Zsh script from an attacker-controlled domain for immediate execution.

infrastructure.name: AMOS Initial Access Website
infrastructure.description: A malicious website (getmacouscloud.com) hosting deceptive setup instructions to trick users into running malicious commands.

infrastructure.name: AMOS Payload Staging Server
infrastructure.description: A domain (ferncore13.com) used to host the initial Zsh script payload downloaded by the curl command.

infrastructure.name: AMOS C2 Server
infrastructure.description: Command and control server used to receive exfiltrated data, including credentials and wallet information, via HTTP POST requests. Observed IPs include 161.35.146.120 and 188.166.78.138.

indicators.name: AMOS Stealer C2 Network Indicators
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: AMOS Stealer C2 DNS Query
id: 2b8c9d0e-1f3a-4b6c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS queries to domains associated with Atomic macOS (AMOS) Stealer infrastructure.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/atomic-macos-amos-stealer-activity/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-16
tags:
  - attack.t1071.004
  - attack.command_and_control
level: high
logsource:
  category: dns_query
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|endswith:
      - 'getmacouscloud.com'
      - 'ferncore13.com'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects network traffic to domains, IPs, or URLs associated with AMOS Stealer C2 infrastructure.

indicators.name: AMOS Stealer File Artifacts
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: AMOS Stealer File Artifacts
id: 3c9d0e1f-2a4b-5c7d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: experimental
description: Detects the presence of files associated with the AMOS Stealer based on their full path.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/atomic-macos-amos-stealer-activity/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-16
tags:
  - attack.t1564.001
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: macos
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '/tmp/helper'
      - '/tmp/starter'
      - '/Library/Application Support/.com.apple.accountsd/.service'
      - '/Library/Application Support/.com.apple.accountsd/AccountsHelper'
      - '/Library/Application Support/.com.apple.metadata.mds/.mdworker'
      - '/Library/Application Support/.com.apple.metadata.mds/mdworker_shared'
      - '/tmp/out.zip'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects files created by the AMOS stealer on an infected macOS system.

indicators.name: Suspicious Script Execution via cURL Pipe on macOS
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Script Execution via cURL Pipe on macOS
id: 4d0e1f2a-3b5c-6d8e-0f1a-2b3c4d5e6f7g
status: experimental
description: Detects the suspicious use of curl to pipe a script directly into a shell interpreter like sh, bash, or zsh on macOS, a technique used by AMOS stealer.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/atomic-macos-amos-stealer-activity/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-16
tags:
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1105
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: macos
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'curl '
      - ' | '
    CommandLine|endswith:
      - 'sh'
      - 'bash'
      - 'zsh'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the `curl | sh` pattern used by AMOS to download and execute its initial payload.

indicators.name: AMOS Stealer Hidden Directory Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: AMOS Stealer Hidden Directory Creation in Application Support
id: 5e1f2a3b-4c6d-7e9f-1a2b-3c4d5e6f7g8h
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of hidden directories (starting with a dot) within /Library/Application Support/, a technique used by AMOS stealer for persistence.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/atomic-macos-amos-stealer-activity/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-16
tags:
  - attack.t1564.001
  - attack.persistence
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: macos
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|startswith: '/Library/Application Support/.'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '/.com.apple.accountsd/'
      - '/.com.apple.metadata.mds/'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of hidden directories in `/Library/Application Support/`, a persistence and defense evasion technique used by AMOS.
